card.name: The words crowded and squeezed
card.fires_on: The words "crowded" and "squeezed" (also similar words about packing into tight space), mostly after a form of "be" or "become" or after a comma. Seen in general web text about places, plants, animals or objects packed tightly.

modes.label: crowded
modes.description: The word "crowded" describing places or things packed with people, animals or plants.
modes.example: Behind the Basilica there are<< crowded>> squares and streets with restaurants, tourist shops

modes.label: squeezed
modes.description: The word "squeezed" meaning forced into a small space or pressed out of a tube.
modes.example: It can be<< squeezed>> into a one hour teaching slot, though
